# Web canvas blocks

Every block of `Pema Web redesign canvas` with the `src/ui` component it renders, its KMP `core:ui` analogue and the rules for using it. The last column is how often the 81 canvas screen(s) built so far use it. Helper arguments and examples: `.claude/skills/pema-web-design/references/blocks-web.md`.

| Block | Helper | Kit component | KMP analogue | Rules | Used in the canvas |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `h` | `h h1 h2 h3 h4` | heading element (`PageHeading` for a page title; no component for h2-h4) | `PemaHeading`, `PemaSection` | h1 = page/hero title 25, h2 = 20, h3 = card title 16, h4 = 15. Optional sub line and eyebrow | 105 blocks · 46 screens |
| `pageHead` | `pageHead(title, sub, actions, eyebrow)` | `PageHeading` (`workspace.tsx`) | `PemaHeading` | One per page, first block. Actions are inline blocks (buttons) | 53 blocks · 53 screens |
| `hero` | `hero(title, sub, icon, { over, actions })` | kit gap (gradient hero) | `PemaHero` | Identity areas only, never behind tables or notes. **web-only use** (app uses it on home tabs) | 3 blocks · 3 screens |
| `kpis` | `kpi(label, value, note, o)`, `kpis(...)` | `Tile` (`tile.tsx`) | `PemaMetrics`, `PemaTile` | Any count 1-6 in one row (390: 2 per row). Tile = label, value 27/700, note; `unit`, `icon`, `chev`, `tone`, `actions: [btn]` | 27 blocks · 25 screens |
| `stat` | `stat(label, value, sub, { unit })` | kit gap (plain text label/value cell) | `PemaCardLine` | Small summary cell, e.g. "Liệu trình hiện tại / Buổi đã hoàn tất" in a `grid(3, ...)` | 12 blocks · 5 screens |
| `chips` | `chips(items, { vert })` | `FilterChip` (shared, `ops-ui.tsx`) | `PemaChipWrap`, `PemaFilterChip` | Filter pills: `'Tất cả'` or `[label, 'sel'|'dis'|'', count]`. `vert` stacks them (group lists with counts) | 23 blocks · 23 screens |
| `tags` | `tags(...badges)` | `Badge` (`badge.tsx`) in a row | `PemaPillButton` | Wrapping row of badges as one leaf (hero chips) | 24 blocks · 21 screens |
| `tabs` | `tabs(items, activeIndex, { seg })` | `Tabs` (`tabs.tsx`) | none (app uses bottom nav) | Underline bar; `seg` = segmented control (Ngày / 7 ngày). Item `'label'` or `[label, count]`. 390: equal pills | 29 blocks · 29 screens |
| `notice` | `notice(text, tone, { title, actions })` | `Notice` (shared) | `PemaNotice` | tone `info warning danger success`; text verbatim; `actions: [btn]` for notices with buttons | 62 blocks · 45 screens |
| `facts` | `facts([label, value, { sub }], ...)` | kit gap (`Facts`, label left / value right rows) | `PemaCardLine` | Key facts, dividers between rows | 8 blocks · 8 screens |
| `field` | `field(label, o)` and `input select date time month number textarea check radio search file range` | `Field` (`field.tsx`) | `PemaTextField`, `PemaDropdownField`, `PemaSearchField`, `PemaCheckRow` | One field per old field, label verbatim. `o`: `req hint err ph lines opts open dis w`. `select(..., { open: true, opts })` shows the option list | 212 blocks · 61 screens |
| `table` | `table(cols, rows, { foot })`, `cell(items, { row })` | `TableShell` (`table-shell.ts`, re-export) | none (cards `PemaCareRow` on mobile) | Up to 7 columns. At 390 every row becomes a card (first cell = title, others under their column label). Use a table for 3+ comparable rows, `list` or cards otherwise | 23 blocks · 23 screens |
| `empty` | `empty(title, hint, { icon, actions })` | `EmptyState` (`empty-state.tsx`) | `PemaEmpty` | Say what is missing and the one action that fixes it | 18 blocks · 17 screens |
| `bars` | `bars([label, count, pct, tone], ...)` | kit gap | none | Dashboard "Lịch hẹn theo trạng thái"; `pct` 0-100, tone `success warning danger info` | 11 blocks · 5 screens |
| `timeline` | `timeline({ date, title, detail, by, icon, tone }, ...)` | kit gap | `PemaTile` list (J8) | Patient journey / history. Dot icon + connector line | 2 blocks · 2 screens |
| `list` | `list(items, { box, plain, ordered })` | kit gap | `PemaTile`, `PemaCareRow` | Rows `{ t, sub, sub2, over, icon, avatar, actions }`; `ordered` numbers them, `plain` = text lines (guide steps), `box` = bordered rows (wait cards) | 49 blocks · 32 screens |
| `board` | `board({ rooms, from, to, hh, legend })` (alias `week`) | kit gap | `WeekStrip` (partial) | **web-only.** Rooms × time, bookings positioned by start/mins. 390: one list per room | 1 blocks · 1 screens |
| `weekGrid` | `weekGrid({ days, legend })` | kit gap | `WeekStrip` (partial) | **web-only.** 7 day columns of booking cards with "Đặt lịch" per day. 390: one list per day | 1 blocks · 1 screens |
| `photos` | `photos(items, { n })` (alias `photoGrid`) | kit gap | photo tile / `LocalPhoto` | Placeholders only, always with the tag "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"; `{ empty: true }` for a missing photo, `{ slider: true }` for the slider compare | 6 blocks · 6 screens |
| `a5` | `a5({ title, draft, rows, items, note, signDate, signRole, signName })` | kit gap (print sheet) | `A5PrintPreviewScreen` | **web-only.** Portrait paper (148 × 210), 2 per row in a `grid(2, ...)` | 0 blocks · 0 screens |
| `img` | `img(label, { icon, h })` | kit gap | none | Neutral image placeholder | 3 blocks · 3 screens |
| `legend` | `legend(items)` | kit gap | none | Service colour legend (boards add it themselves) | 0 blocks · 0 screens |
| `sp` | `sp(h)` | none | `Spacer` | Vertical gap in px | 2 blocks · 2 screens |
| `hr` | `hr()` | none | none | Divider | 26 blocks · 22 screens |
| `code` | `code(text)` | none | none | Monospace block for raw text | 0 blocks · 0 screens |
| `stack` | `stack({ g }, ...kids)` | none (plain flex column) | `Column` | Container. `g` gap px, default 12 | 100 blocks · 49 screens |
| `row` | `row({ g, ai, jc }, ...kids)` | none (plain flex row, wraps) | `Row` | Container. `ai` align-items, `jc` justify-content (`'space-between'`, `'flex-end'`) | 231 blocks · 69 screens |
| `grid` | `grid(cols, ...kids)`, `grid({ cols, colsn, g }, ...)`, `split(main, aside)` | `Workspace` (split / cards layout) or plain grid | none | Container. `cols`: number (equal columns), CSS template (`'minmax(0,1.65fr) minmax(300px,1fr)'`) ; `colsn` = template at 390 (default one column, two for 4+ equal columns) | 105 blocks · 57 screens |
| `card` | `card({ title, sub, eyebrow, aside, v, g }, ...kids)`, `panel(title, sub, aside, ...kids)` | `Card` (`card.tsx`) | `PemaInfoCard` | Container. `v`: `panel` (default) `soft` `ai` (pale brand, "Pema AI · bản nháp") `plain` `flush` `hero` (patient card). `aside` = inline blocks on the header's right | 205 blocks · 73 screens |
| `box` | `box(tone, ...kids)`, `box({ tone, title }, ...kids)` | kit gap (rich notice container) | `PemaNotice` | Container. Callout with children (fields, badges, buttons), e.g. a notice that holds a slider | 4 blocks · 4 screens |
| `disc` | `disc(summary, ...kids)` | kit gap (disclosure) | none | Container. The old `<details>` (finance "+ Ghi nhận lượt thủ thuật…"), drawn open | 1 blocks · 1 screens |
| `txt` | `txt(text, o)`, `sm lbl strong eyebrow kv` | text element | `PemaText` | Inline. See helper reference | 990 blocks · 66 screens |
| `btn` | `btn(text, variant, o)`, `primary secondary quiet danger lnk iconBtn` | `Button` (`button.tsx`) | `PemaPrimary`, `PemaOutlinedButton`, `PemaTextButton` | Inline. Variants `primary secondary danger dangers quiet link` | 604 blocks · 80 screens |
| `badge` | `badge(text, tone, { dot })` | `Badge` (`badge.tsx`) | `PemaPillButton` | Inline. Tones `neutral brand info success warning danger`; the text is always the status | 166 blocks · 36 screens |
| `avatar` | `avatar(text, { size })` | kit gap (initials circle) | avatar in `PemaTile` | Inline. Sizes `sm md lg` | 44 blocks · 22 screens |
| `icon` | `ico(name, { size, tone })` | icon (`icons.tsx`) | `PemaIcon` (Material) | Inline. Material Symbols Outlined name; a wrong name shows as text and `check` reports `badIcons` | 19 blocks · 7 screens |
| `chip` | `chip(text, state, count)` | `FilterChip` (shared) | `PemaFilterChip` | Inline single pill; use `chips` for a group | 15 blocks · 5 screens |
| `prog` | `prog(pct, { label, tone })` | kit gap | none | Inline progress bar | 25 blocks · 10 screens |
